name: Thieves’ Tools
description:
Picks, a file, scissors, a mirror and pliers support lock and trap work. Appropriate proficiency applies to relevant checks.

Uses the 2014 rules; the GM resolves applicability. Legality depends on the campaign.

name: Replacement Lockpicks
description:
Three replacement picks repair the contents of a thieves’ tools set. This incomplete assortment is not a full tool kit.

Legality and provenance depend on the campaign. The GM confirms restrictions and any checks; this item grants no automatic access, immunity or bonus.
